Class MainCharacter

java.lang.Object
com.sfuparkingmayhem.game.Entity
com.sfuparkingmayhem.game.MovingEntity
com.sfuparkingmayhem.game.MainCharacter
public class MainCharacter extends MovingEntity
This MainCharacter class extends MovingEntity class and contains the following methods: a constructor to instantiate a MainCharacter, a method to get the image of this MainCharacter, and a move method allowing this MainCharacter to move Left,Right,Up,and Down on game board.

    • collectCoins

      protected void collectCoins()
      Removes a coin from coins ArrayList if this MainCharacter's board position matches a coin's board position. Must create a copy of coins ArrayList to prevent iterating and removing (deleting) from same ArrayList, which is not allowed.

    • collectLostNote

      protected void collectLostNote()
      Removes a lostNote from ln ArrayList if this MainCharacter's board position matches a lostNote's board position. Must create a copy of ln ArrayList to prevent iterating and removing (deleting) from same ArrayList, which is not allowed.
